description: Disconnects the phone system (Quo) as the Phone card's Disconnect does: deregisters Quo's webhook and turns off its saved credentials and phone numbers (kept for the audit trail). Texts stop flowing through Sergio until it is reconnected on the same card. Nothing is sent to clients. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying; a repeat is the same disconnect. An owner-level change: Sergio tells the owner after it is made.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

reason.description: Why you are doing this, in one sentence. The owner sees it in the notice Sergio sends after the change.

name: disconnect_openphone
title: Disconnect Quo (phone)
